slots.jd.school-district.about:
Duties
Ashgrove Unified School District is seeking a Classroom Teacher to join an elementary school team in Ashgrove, Ohio. Under the general direction of the building principal, the teacher plans and delivers instruction aligned with the district curriculum, keeps a safe and orderly classroom, monitors student progress, and works with families and staff to support student learning. This is an on-site position.
slots.jd.school-district.duties:
Responsibilities of the position
- Plan and lead small-group reading sessions matched to student needs and reading levels.
- Hold parent conferences to review student progress, share work samples and agree on next steps.
- Take part in team planning with grade-level colleagues to align units, materials and assessments.
- Monitor student progress through ongoing classroom checks and adjust instruction based on results.
- Maintain clear classroom routines and expectations that support a safe learning environment.
- Communicate regularly with families about classroom activities and student growth.
slots.jd.school-district.needs:
Qualifications and conditions of employment
- 4 or more years of experience as an elementary classroom teacher.
- Demonstrated classroom management and parent communication skills.
- Experience using differentiated instruction and math manipulatives in daily lessons.
- Working knowledge of phonics instruction and reading intervention practices.
- Required: a valid State Teaching Licence.
- Preferred: Instructional Leadership Endorsement.
slots.r1.b1: Adapts reading and math tasks for different learners through Nearpod lessons with built-in supports, raising average unit quiz scores by 15 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Tracks student progress with regular classroom checks and shares results through ongoing parent communication so families know where each child stands.
slots.r1.b3: Builds formative assessment into daily classroom routines such as exit tickets and quick checks, reducing off-task time during transitions by 40 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Plans daily math lessons around math manipulatives so students model concepts with concrete objects before moving to written work.
slots.r1.i1: Teaches a full elementary class at Hillcrest Elementary School, with a daily focus on small-group reading matched to each student's level.
slots.r1.i2: Leads an elementary classroom at Hillcrest Elementary School and assesses student progress regularly to guide instruction and grouping.
slots.r2.b1: Led small-group reading sessions using differentiated instruction, grouping students by need and raising the share of students reading at grade level by 40 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Planned units with grade-level colleagues and agreed on shared behavior supports so expectations stayed consistent across classrooms.
slots.r2.b3: Used ClassDojo to schedule parent conferences and send progress updates, increasing conference attendance by 15 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Applied classroom management routines that freed time to adapt work for different learners, including modified tasks and extra practice.
slots.r2.i1: Supported instruction at Willowbrook Elementary School as an associate teacher, assessing student progress and using the results to adjust lessons.
slots.r2.i2: Worked as an associate teacher at Willowbrook Elementary School, planning lessons and units alongside grade-level colleagues.
slots.summary.1: Elementary teacher with about 4 years of experience running a full class without close supervision. Uses Nearpod, behavior supports and math manipulatives to keep lessons structured and accessible for different learners.
slots.summary.2: Classroom teacher with 4 years of elementary experience, currently managing a full class independently at Hillcrest Elementary School. Plans lessons with Nearpod and math manipulatives and applies behavior supports to maintain a steady learning environment.
